Summaries.eng:
Tightly clutching his Gibson guitar, Mafuyu Satou steps out of his dark apartment to begin another day of his high school life. While taking a nap in a quiet spot on the gymnasium staircase, he has a chance encounter with fellow student Ritsuka Uenoyama, who berates him for letting his guitar's strings rust and break. Noticing Uenoyama's knowledge of the instrument, Satou pleads for him to fix it and to teach him how to play. Uenoyama eventually agrees and invites him to sit in on a jam session with his two band mates: bassist Haruki Nakayama and drummer Akihiko Kaji.

Satou's voice is strikingly beautiful, filling Uenoyama with the determination to make Satou the lead singer of the band. Though reticent at first, Satou takes the offer after an emotional meeting with an old friend. With the support of his new friends, Satou must not only learn how to play guitar, but also come to terms with the mysterious circumstances that led him to be its owner.
Summaries.jpn: プロ顔負けのギターの腕前を持つ高校生の上ノ山立夏（鈴木仁）は、大学生の梶秋彦（井之脇海）と大学院生の中山春樹（栁俊太郎）の３人でインストバンドを組んでいる。以前はあんなに音楽にのめりこんでいたのに、何もかもがくすんで見え始めていたある日、立夏が校内で誰にも邪魔されないいつもの場所へ向かうと、壊れたギターを抱えた佐藤真冬（さなり）に出会う。仕方なく弦を直してやると、真冬からギターの弾き方を教えてほしいと頼まれる。はじめは渋っていた立夏だが、真冬の透き通るような歌声を聞いて衝撃を受け、バンドに入らないか？と誘うが、真冬から断られてしまう。いつしか立夏は、真冬の存在が気になり始め・・・

Summaries.eng: Ritsuka Uenoyama is an excellent guitarist and high school student. One day as he's heading up the stairs to go to the roof, he discovers a mysterious student sitting on the stairs holding a Gibson with broken strings named Mafuyu Sato. Mafuyu persistently asks Ritsuka to teach him guitar and Ritsuka ends up bringing him to the band practice of his band, "the seasons." Ritsuka performs for Mafuyu along with his bandmates, the drummer Akihiko Kaji and bassist Haruki Nakayama. Ritsuka's face is beaming as he performs...

Ritsuka starts teaching Mafuyu how to play guitar. Ritsuka couldn't help but wonder why a beginner like Mafuyu would have a guitar like the Gibson he owned. One day, Ritsuka hears Mafuyu sing and it rocks him to the core so he asks Mafuyu to join his band, the seasons. To his surprise, Mafuyu declines. Then suddenly, someone named Hiiragi Kashima appears and he seems to know about Mafuyu's past...

In order to try to convince Mafuyu to join their band, Ritsuka takes the song that Mafuyu has stuck in his head and arranges it a bit. Mafuyu is a very quick learner and progressing pretty quickly with playing guitar and the band is on a roll as they find out that their first live show is coming up. But then, Ritsuka's classmate Ayano Kasai tells Ritsuka something about Mafuyu's past that shakes him up. Even then, Ritsuka starts to realize his feelings towards Mafuyu.

Mafuyu has been on Ritsuka's mind lately and while they're at band practice, he keeps pointing out everything Mafuyu is doing wrong and can't seem to hide his frustrations. Meanwhile, Mafuyu still hasn't written any lyrics. Akihiko proposes they stop practicing and he ends up talking to Ritsuka privately, pointing out that Ritsuka clearly has feelings for Mafuyu. Ritsuka is unsure if he should admit his feelings towards Mafuyu, but then he sees Mafuyu asleep as he is hugging a guitar, just like when they first met.

Ritsuka is scared of the lyrics Mafuyu is going to come up with and Ritsuka can't sort through his feelings. Meanwhile, Mafuyu's childhood friend Hiiragi tells Mafuyu that he regrets knowing everything that happened between him and his former boyfriend Yuki Yoshida. After talking to Hiiragi, Mafuyu is able to face his past a little better and invites him to their concert. But on the day of the concert, Mafuyu finds himself unable to sing.
